meta.name: Ziddi Ishq
meta.description: Mehul, a young woman whose innocent crush on her tuition teacher, Shekhar Da, develops into a dangerous obsession. After his death is ruled a suicide, Mehul refuses to accept the official story and begins her own investigation, which leads her to uncover a tangled web of secrets and lies.

videos.title: First Meeting
videos.overview: Mehul, a young woman whose innocent crush on her tuition teacher, Shekhar Da, develops into a dangerous obsession. After his death is ruled a suicide, Mehul refuses to accept the official story and begins her own investigation, which leads her to uncover a tangled web of secrets and lies

videos.title: Jinxed Fate
videos.overview: Following the altercation with Mousumi, Mehul starts searching for Sayantika. After receiving a mysterious message, Mehul and her friend Anand travel to Darjeeling.

videos.title: A Painful Incident
videos.overview: Mehul lands a job at Unicorn and investigates Raka, the security chief of Unicorn's CEO, Sidharth Roy Chowdhury. She discovers that Raka had a deadly past.

videos.title: The Bitter Truth
videos.overview: During their investigation of Raka, Mehul and Anand find Solanki and her son. When the duo visit her house, they learn a disturbing truth.

videos.title: A Stranger
videos.overview: While Sidharth's attention towards Mehul increases, Mousumi finally agrees to talk to her about Shekhar. Mehul gets another anonymous message, asking her to return to Darjeeling.

videos.title: Beautiful Valleys
videos.overview: Mehul reaches Darjeeling and finds the person she is looking for. Mousumi and Anand, searching for Mehul, meet Solanki.

videos.title: The Final Path
videos.overview: Sidharth invites Mehul to a party, promising to introduce her to his family. However, she confronts him, accusing him of being responsible for Shekhar's death.
